column1: # Throughput MEASURED on Apple M5 Max / 128 GB / macOS 26.4 / MLX 0.32.1 /
# mtplx 2.10.1, 2026-09-01. NOT MEASURED ON A 64 GB MACHINE.
# need_mib is the measured WEIGHTS footprint (27.9 GB = 28,570 MiB), not
# weights plus KV cache -- the KV cache was not separately instrumented. It is
# a floor, and the launcher's pre-flight against it is a warning, not a gate.
#   profile     ctx      measured decode   effective   ttft
#   fast         65536   EXTRAPOLATED -- less KV, expected faster; NOT MEASURED
# `coding` is the row with a measured session behind it. `fast` halves the
# context to buy headroom on a smaller machine; its sizing is arithmetic, not
# a measurement, and it is labelled so.
coding|131072|3|low|32768|28570|default; the measured configuration -- 128k ctx, effort low
fast|65536|3|low|32768|28570|EXTRAPOLATED sizing; half the context for headroom on 64GB
